implementation.staging_status: header, source and focused model test are present and build and run clean at -O0/-O2 with and without NDEBUG under g++ -m32 and clang++ -m32
implementation.canonical_status: not present; canonical promotion is not claimed
implementation.types: OpaqueToolState and OpaqueToolSubject are raw extent models that exist only to carry the observed displacements; no concrete class, owner or member meaning is claimed. The SDK symbol table has no name for 0x0105a050 and SporeApp.exe carries no MSVC RTTI, so nothing here is named from either.
implementation.binding: The declared entry reproduces the 57-instruction body gate for gate: the mode update decides the return value, the positive-active-time test, the owned-subject null test, the three-way subject liveness test, the tool gate word test, the two trail out-parameters, and the forwarding of the back trail point plus the second active-time read to the axis-snap port on the root accessor singleton.
implementation.test_binding: Nine focused cases drive the gate through the ports: a false mode update is the only path that returns false and it touches nothing else; a non-positive active time, a null owned subject, a quiet subject and a closed tool gate each return true with no further call; each of the two subject flags alone opens the gate; the open gate reads the active time twice, fills both trail out-parameters and forwards the back one together with the reach value; the fourth entry slot is not forwarded; the receiver and its subject are byte-identical before and after every case.

observed_original_abi.convention_ambiguity: the body loads its first stack argument into ESI, reloads it into ECX before every thiscall callee and never reads ECX on entry, which is the receiver shape; a plain four-argument __stdcall reading cannot be excluded from this body alone, but the ECX reloads before 0x0104bdb0, 0x0104cd40 and 0x00cb8ba0 are only meaningful as a receiver register.
observed_original_abi.receiver_note: the receiver is read at three displacements and is never written; it is the this of the two receiver getters and is the first ordinary argument of the mode update.
observed_original_abi.stack_argument_use: the first three slots are read at entry and forwarded to the mode update; the fourth slot, entry ESP+0x10, is never read and is dropped, because the fourth word the mode update receives is an immediate zero pushed by this body
observed_original_abi.termination: RET 0x10 at 0x0105a0f0 on the false path and RET 0x10 at 0x0105a0f9 on the true path
observed_original_abi.return_type_rationale: both exits write AL only: MOV AL,0x1 at 0x0105a0ea and XOR AL,AL at 0x0105a0f3. The declared bool is the 8-bit claim the machine supports; the upper three bytes of EAX are whatever the last callee left and no claim is made about them. The live decompilation types the function undefined4, and the caller at 0x0105a890 consumes the result with TEST AL,AL, which is consistent with an 8-bit return.
observed_original_abi.frame: SUB ESP,0x18 then PUSH ESI at 0x0105a058/0x0105a0b5; the epilogue POP ESI / ADD ESP,0x18 / RET 0x10 balances it exactly, which fixes the entry ESP and every frame-relative address in the body
observed_original_abi.ghidra_prototype: undefined4 FUN_0105a050(int param_1, undefined4 param_2, undefined4 param_3)
observed_original_abi.ghidra_convention_note: the live decompilation reports three parameters and no receiver because the prologue establishes its frame after the two argument reads; the fourth entry slot and the ECX receiver are read off the listing, not off that signature

observed_mechanics: instruction_count 57; body 0x0105a050 through the RET 0x10 at 0x0105a0f9, ending at 0x0105a0fb, followed by INT3 padding to 0x0105a0ff

0x0105a050: MOV EAX,[ESP + 0xc] and 0x0105a054: MOV EDX,[ESP + 0x8] read the third and second arguments before the frame exists; 0x0105a05c: MOV ESI,[ESP + 0x20] with ESP already at entry-0x1c reads entry ESP+0x4, the first argument, into ESI

0x0105a060..0x0105a065: PUSH 0x0 / PUSH EAX / PUSH EDX / PUSH ESI / CALL 0x010593e0 forwards the first three arguments unchanged and substitutes an immediate zero for the fourth; ECX is not set, so the callee receives the receiver as an ordinary argument
0x0105a06a: TEST AL,AL and 0x0105a06c: JZ 0x0105a0f3 make the mode update the only source of a false return

0x0105a072..0x0105a081: MOV ECX,ESI / CALL 0x0104bdb0 / FLDZ / FXCH / FCOMIP ST0,ST1 / FSTP ST0 / JBE 0x0105a0ea compare the receiver's active time against zero and continue only when it is greater than zero
0x0105a083..0x0105a08b: MOV ECX,[ESI + 0x124] / TEST ECX,ECX / JZ 0x0105a0ea require a non-null owned subject

0x0105a08d..0x0105a0ac: CALL 0x00cb5ba0 on the owned subject, then CMP byte ptr [EAX + 0x16c],0x0 and CMP byte ptr [EAX + 0x16d],0x0, open the gate when the subject reports itself live or when either of its two flag bytes is non-zero; all three tests failing jumps to the true exit
0x0105a0ae..0x0105a0b7: MOV ECX,ESI / CALL 0x0104cd40 / TEST AL,AL / JZ 0x0105a0ea require the receiver's gate word to pass

0x0105a0b9..0x0105a0c9: LEA EAX,[ESP + 0x4] / PUSH EAX / LEA ECX,[ESP + 0x14] / PUSH ECX / CALL 0x00cb8ba0 pass two out-parameters, the back point at frame+0x4 and the front point at frame+0x10, to the subject's trail reader, which pops its own eight bytes with RET 0x8

0x0105a0ce..0x0105a0e5: MOV ECX,ESI / CALL 0x0104bdb0 re-reads the active time, PUSH ECX reserves the float's stack slot, LEA EDX,[ESP + 0x8] recomputes the back point at frame+0x4, FSTP float ptr [ESP] writes the float into the reserved slot, PUSH EDX pushes the point, CALL 0x00b3d430 produces the singleton, MOV ECX,EAX makes it the receiver and CALL 0x00bbec40 consumes the point and the float
0x0105a0ea: MOV AL,0x1 is the single true exit and every gated path reaches it, so the body reports whether the mode update ran and not whether the follow-up work happened
0x0105a0f3: XOR AL,AL is the only false exit and is reached only from the JZ at 0x0105a06c

no instruction in the body writes through the receiver or through the owned subject; the only stores are the six floats 0x00cb8ba0 writes into the two frame out-parameters and the float the FSTP writes into its own reserved argument slot
no instruction in the body reads or names a data-segment address; the singleton the axis-snap port needs is produced by the callee at 0x00b3d430, not by a load in this body
direct callees 7, each reached by a direct CALL with no tail jump: 0x010593e0, 0x0104bdb0 (twice), 0x0104cd40, 0x00cb5ba0, 0x00cb8ba0, 0x00b3d430, 0x00bbec40
incoming direct calls 3: 0x0105a128 from FUN_0105a110, 0x0105a8af from FUN_0105a890, and 0x0105bd33, an address Ghidra has placed in no function
the two immediate words the body itself pushes are 0x0, the substituted fourth argument, and 0x1, the true return
the frame-relative displacements the body forms are 0x4, 0x8, 0xc, 0x14, 0x18, 0x20 and 0x124; the object displacements it reads are 0x124, 0x16c, 0x16d, 0x174 and 0x1ac
x87 use is confined to the zero comparison and the single argument store: FLDZ, FXCH, FCOMIP, FSTP and one FSTP to memory; no other floating-point instruction appears in the body
layout_evidence: receiver + 0x124: read three times at 0x0105a083, 0x0105a096 and 0x0105a0c3; a null value takes the true exit, a non-null value is the this of 0x00cb5ba0 and 0x00cb8ba0; never written
receiver + 0x174: read through 0x0104cd40, whose body is (word >> 3) & 0xffffff01 tested through AL; never written by this body
receiver + 0x1ac: read as a float twice through 0x0104bdb0, once against zero and once as the value forwarded with the back trail point; never written
owned subject + 0x16c and + 0x16d: two bytes each compared against zero; either one non-zero opens the gate when 0x00cb5ba0 reports the subject not live
owned subject + 0x1e0: read through 0x00cb5ba0, whose whole body is (word != 0) tested through AL

owned subject + 0x1e4 and + 0x1e8: read inside 0x00cb8ba0 as the begin and end of a twelve-byte-stride trail; the trail length is (end - begin) / 12 and the front and back points are copied out when the count exceeds one
no member of either object is named here; the model exists only to carry these displacements and the extents they imply

vtable_evidence: 0x0105a050 is the target of two DATA references, 0x0149b808 and 0x0149b948, so it is a virtual function reached through a table rather than only through the two direct callers

the two slots are 0x140 bytes apart and are framed identically: the two words before each are 0x01053d50 and 0x01053bb0, the word after each is distinct (0x01059f20 and 0x0105aa50), and both are followed by the same eight-word tail 0x01053db0, 0x01052f00, 0x01053be0, 0x010937e0, 0x01054ec0, 0x01053e00, 0x00c6a960, 0x007b86e0
a third table holds 0x0105a890 at 0x0149b8f8, the same offset within that run, and 0x0105a890 is one of this function's callers and gates its whole body on this function's result

the base address of the run is not established from these reads, so no slot index and no class name is claimed, and the briefing's vtable records at 0x0149b8b4 and 0x0149b900 are recorded as index-side claims that this pass did not confirm against the bytes
global_reader_evidence: this body names no data-segment address; the singleton the final port needs is produced by 0x00b3d430, whose own two-instruction body is MOV EAX,[0x0167eb30] / RET, so the global read belongs to that callee and not to 0x0105a050

callee_observations.observed: four ordinary stack arguments, no ECX receiver set by the caller, result consumed through AL; its own body returns 1 on each of its early exits (null first argument, null word at 0x30 of the first argument) and again at its end, dereferences the first argument as a polymorphic object through words at 0x18, 0x38, 0x74, 0x78 and 0xb8 and through the word at 0x114, and switches on the third argument over the values 0 to 3; the meaning of those four arguments is not established here
two-instruction-equivalent getter returning the float at receiver+0x1ac in x87 ST0; no stack traffic
predicate whose whole body is the word at subject+0x1e0 compared against zero, returned through AL
predicate over the word at receiver+0x174, computed as (word >> 3) & 0xffffff01 and returned through AL; whether that is a bit test or a range comparison is not settled by the decompilation

writes two twelve-byte points through two out-parameters, the front and the back of a trail held between the subject words at 0x1e4 and 0x1e8 with a twelve-byte stride, and falls back to a projected point built from the sub-object at 0x34 and the axis triple at 0x160, 0x164 and 0x168 scaled by a distance; pops its two arguments with RET 0x8
MOV EAX,[0x0167eb30] / RET, an argumentless global-slot accessor; reconstructed elsewhere in this repository as root_accessor_00b3d430

seven-instruction body that loads its second argument as a float, copies its first argument, reserves a fresh stack slot for that float, pushes the pointer and calls 0x00bbdff0 with the unchanged ECX as receiver, then RET 0x8; the inner callee quantises a direction onto axis vectors and clears held input-key state, and returns a value in x87 ST0 that this body leaves on the FPU stack

caller_evidence: 0x0105a110 (FUN_0105a110) pushes an immediate zero and three stack words and gates its whole body on the result, jumping to its own constant-true exit when the result is false
0x0105a890 (FUN_0105a890) is itself a table word, forwards its receiver and its first three arguments unchanged, substitutes an immediate zero, and returns 1 immediately when the result is false

0x0105bd33 is a direct call into this function from an address Ghidra places in no function, so no calling context is established for it; the raw bytes around it push an immediate zero and three stack words in the same order as the other two call sites, but that region has no confirmed instruction boundary and is not used as evidence here

unresolved_questions: What class owns this function. The two DATA references place it at the same offset in two table runs 0x140 bytes apart and a third run holds the caller 0x0105a890 there, but the run's base address is unknown, so the function is named only by its address.
What the receiver and the owned subject are. Three receiver words and three subject words are read, and nothing in this body or in the SDK says what any of them mean.

Whether 0x0104cd40's (word >> 3) & 0xffffff01 is a bit test or a range comparison; the mask keeps bit 3 and bits 11 through 31 of the word and clears the rest, and the body only asks whether the result is non-zero.

Whether the fourth entry stack slot, which RET 0x10 pops and no instruction reads, was an argument at the source level or padding; the body substitutes its own immediate zero for the callee's fourth word, so the slot's value cannot reach any callee.

Whether 0x010593e0 pops its four arguments or the caller cleans them, which decides whether the mode-update port is __stdcall or __cdecl; the port is declared caller-cleaned here because this body's listing does not show an ADD ESP after the call, and the callee's own epilogue was not disassembled.

Whether the back trail point forwarded to 0x00bbec40 is the intended argument, given that the front point is computed into the adjacent frame slot and never read; the listing is unambiguous about which pointer is pushed, and this reconstruction follows the listing rather than the intuition.
Why 0x00bbec40 leaves a value in x87 ST0 that its own caller ignores.
What the third call site at 0x0105bd33 is, since Ghidra defines no function containing it.
